facts.text: The README describes the project as a ROS 2 driver and tools for SICK LiDAR and RADAR devices.
The README says the project provides a driver for SICK LiDARs and Radar sensors and supports ROS 2.
The ROS 2 build depends on rclcpp.
For ROS 2 the wrapper defines ros_sensor_msgs as sensor_msgs::msg.
The scan topic defaults to nodename + "/scan" and is then read from the laserscan_topic parameter.
The node advertises ros_sensor_msgs::LaserScan on the configured laserscan_topic with queue size 1000.
The LMS5xx launch example defaults laserscan_topic to scan and nodename to sick_lms_5xx.
The LaserScan header stamp is the receive time plus the configured time offset, and the header frame_id is the configured frame_id.
The scan telegram parser fills angle_min, angle_increment and angle_max from the reported start angle and angular step.
The parser copies the configured range_min and range_max into the LaserScan.
When min_intensity is greater than zero, scan ranges whose intensity is below that threshold are replaced with positive infinity.
The LMS5xx launch example sets min_intensity to its default 0.0.
The range filter header documents that the range filter applies only to PointCloud messages, not to LaserScan messages.
SickScanExit is documented as stopping the scanner and exiting sick_generic_caller.
The exit path calls stopScanData, moves the run state to scanner_finalize and joins the generic laser driver.
For the non-NAV350 profile, stop_scanner sends a SOPAS LMDscandata stop command; it is a C++ method, not a ROS service.
